summary: First Busey Corp filed an 8-K reporting a letter agreement extending CEO Van A. Dukeman's term through July 1, 2029. Compensation remains unchanged; a one-time retention RSU award of ~$2.07M vests on July 1, 2029, with accelerated vesting on qualifying termination, death, or disability. This is a routine executive compensation arrangement, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activism, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. The filing is a standard current report on compensatory arrangements.
